title: UI to set keyboard shortcut for standalone widgets that have their "configure" actions overridden to open System Settings KCMs
line: Standalone widgets whose Configure entry opens System Settings (Notifications, Bluetooth, Networks…) now have a "Configure Keyboard Shortcut…" entry in their context menu.
explanation: About a dozen widgets (Notifications, Bluetooth, Networks, Audio, Battery, Display Configuration, Printers, Clipboard, Disks & Devices, Input Method, Activity Bar, Icon) replace their Configure action with one that opens a System Settings page or their own dialog. That made the standard widget settings dialog, which holds the Keyboard Shortcuts and About pages, unreachable for them when used outside the system tray, so their activation shortcut could only be set by editing plasma-org.kde.plasma.desktop-appletsrc. Every non-containment applet now gets a hidden internal action "configureShortcut" that opens the standard dialog; it becomes visible only when the applet has replaced its Configure action (and configuring is allowed), and the panel/desktop context menu shows it right after the Configure entry.

commits.message:
Applet: offer keyboard shortcut config when configure is overridden

Notifications, Bluetooth and others make Configure open System Settings,
so as standalone widgets their activation shortcut couldn't be set. Add
a Configure Keyboard Shortcut… entry opening the standard config dialog.

BUG: 503440

media.caption: Notifications widget in the panel, right-click: only "Configure Event Notifications and Actions…" (opens System Settings); no way to set its shortcut
Same menu with the fix: new "Configure Keyboard Shortcut…" entry
Standalone Bluetooth widget: "Configure Bluetooth…" opens System Settings, no shortcut entry
Bluetooth widget with the fix: "Configure Keyboard Shortcut…" entry
The entry opens the standard widget settings dialog on its Keyboard Shortcuts page (About page also reachable); Meta+Alt+N being assigned
After OK, pressing Meta+Alt+N opens the standalone Notifications widget
